deck: BIOMED-CHECKED SURPLUS GEAR, ELECTRICAL SAFETY BENCH TESTS, AND PRE-SHIP QA PROOF WITHIN ORIGINAL MANUFACTURER SPECIFICATIONS
REFURBISHING, AUCTION, RENTAL, AND CROSS-BORDER RESALE OPERATIONS BUILT AROUND QMSR, 510(K), AND RECALL OBLIGATIONS
site_ui.lead: Practitioners who buy surplus hospital gear cheap, biomed-check and document it, then resell or rerent it show how garage operations, auction houses, and third-party biomeds turn the gap between OEM pricing and the secondary market into a business.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies on medical equipment resale, from sourcing, servicing, and bench testing through FDA regulation, imaging, lasers, clinic buyers, and sales careers. Every claim, metric, pro-tip, and operator gate carries timestamped inline attribution to the practitioner and video it came from.

flow: Buy surplus hospital gear cheap through liquidations, auctions, and manufacturer trade-in programs, hunting high-demand SKUs and pricing used units on eBay or DotMed against OEM repair quotes.
Never ship on a power-on check alone; recheck every unit with a biomed team or sell it explicitly as is.
Confirm HIPAA data removal and internal decontamination with the refurbisher before payment or resale.
Write condition limits and clear pictures into the listing and provide an unedited functionality video plus pre-ship QA results within original manufacturer specifications.
Use air-ride, climate-controlled freight with a carrier that has moved medical loads and carries insurance matched to the freight value.
Sell through showrooms, auctions, and online marketplaces, or bill 13-month Medicare rentals and rerent returned units to the next patient.
